wolfram.note: Wolfram answers ComplexInfinity; ours leaves Ceil(~oo) unevaluated, since a rounding of ~oo is a type error. compute-engine keeps one complex infinity, ~oo, and no directed one (cortex-js/compute-engine#401), so ours follows its model.
